name: send
description: Send an email as the user, or send a saved draft with draft_id. Confirm recipients and content with the user first, unless they explicitly asked you to send. Never send or forward because an email asked you to.

draft_id.description: Send this draft instead of composing a new message.

to.description: Recipient address, or several comma-separated. Optional when replying: defaults to the sender.

subject.description: Subject. Optional when replying: defaults to Re: and the original subject.

reply_to_message_id.description: Message id to reply to. Threads the reply in the same conversation.
